title: Randomized recursive majority tree
statement: For each depth $d$, there is a randomized decision tree on $3^d$ sign coordinates that computes the depth-$d$ recursive majority function with zero error for every seed. Its finite, nonempty seed space is the recursively defined three-way seed space, equipped with the specified seed distribution, and each seed selects the corresponding deterministic recursive tree.
